fusions.name: Scatter from Cover
fusions.desc: Fires 4 pellets through a port in your shield, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage and knocking what it hits 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Breach Round
fusions.desc: Fires one round from behind your shield at an enemy up to 9 tiles away, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour and leaving it [Sundered] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Recoil Drive
fusions.desc: Fires a round into your braced shield and the recoil carries you 4 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Return Fire
fusions.desc: When a blow from anything but fire lands on you, you fire back at the nearest enemy within 9 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
